All In-charge of ROs / SROs

Sub.: Assessment of Damages U/S 14Bof the Act -reg.

Sir,

On a review of the progress of initiation of enquiries U/S14B, it is observed
that many of the offices have not achieved the minimum requirement of
finalization of 80 cases per month per Assessing Officer.

In order to ensure that damages are levied in respect of all establishments
which have defaulted in timely remittance of PF dues, the following line of action
may be taken in addition to the existing procedure being followed in all the
Offices.

1.

At the time of finalization of Annual Accounts, it should be the duty of the
AAO’s to forward a copy of the statement in r/o the establishments which
have defaulted in the timely remittance of PF dues.

. The Annual Accounts of such establishments should not be approved until

the Damages Statement is prepared and placed alongwith the Annual
Accounts.

. The damages section on receipt of the PD statement from the Accounts

Group should take immediate follow-up action for initiation of enquiry U/S
14B.

. Acopy of the notice issued U/S 14B should be marked to the AAO of the

concerned Accounts Group.

. The AAO should maintain a register of all such cases referred to the PD

section. A proforma of the register to be maintained by the AAO is
enclosed.

. The entry against each establishment will be shown as pending until &

unless the PD section finalises the assessment of Damages U/S 14B.

. This register should be reviewed by the APFC(Accounts)/ RC( F & A)

once in a month.

All OICs are requested to ensure compliance of the above instructions by
suitably sensitizing the AAO’s and to ensure that directions are complied with
by the AAO’s and the PD section.

Yours faithfully,

Encl.: As above.

Copy to:
1. FA & CAO / All ACCs in Head Office / CVO
